## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 498 captures during June 2019. This represents the activity submitted by the site for the reporting period. The capture total should be reviewed alongside the image-quality and grading measures below to provide a complete view of site operations.

The clinic should continue to maintain its routine process for image capture and submission. Any operational matters affecting the continuity or completeness of this process should be recorded and followed up through the appropriate local arrangements.

## Image quality

There were 7 ungradable image sets. The ungradable rate was 1.4 per cent of captures. This indicates that most submitted images were suitable for assessment, while the ungradable cases should continue to be monitored as part of routine quality review.

The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Recording these issues will support follow-up and help identify whether further action is required.

## Grading

Grading identified 63 referable results during June 2019. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. This measure should be considered with the volume of captures and the number of referable results when reviewing the site’s operational performance.
